summary: XP Shop feature testing completed successfully. All 32 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend UI testing verified: shop page loads correctly, 21 items displayed with rarity colors, category filters work (5 themes, 3 shields, 4 badges, 3 avatars, 3 effects), inventory tab shows empty state, Featured Items section present, coins display (5) on dashboard links to shop.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: All shop endpoints properly implemented with authentication where required
Backend: 18 default items seeded on first access (themes, badges, streak_shields, avatars, effects)
Backend: Purchase validation works - 'Not enough coins' error returned correctly
Backend: Admin endpoints (create/update/delete items, stats) require admin role
Backend: Streak shields are consumable items with uses_remaining tracking
Frontend: Shop page uses data-testid attributes for testing (shop-screen, user-coins, shop-item-*, buy-*)
Frontend: Rarity colors properly displayed (Common=gray, Uncommon=green, Rare=blue, Epic=purple, Legendary=gold)
Frontend: Category filters work correctly (All, Profile Themes, Custom Badges, Streak Shields, Avatar Frames, Special Effects)
Frontend: Inventory tab shows empty state with 'Browse Shop' button when no items owned
Frontend: Coins display on dashboard links to shop via data-testid='coins-shop-link'
seed_data_creation: 18 default shop items seeded automatically on first /api/shop/items access
context_for_next_testing_agent: XP Shop feature fully tested. Key endpoints: GET /api/shop/categories (5 categories), GET /api/shop/items (18+ items with rarity colors), GET /api/shop/items?category=X (filter by category), GET /api/shop/featured (top selling items), GET /api/shop/inventory (user's purchased items), POST /api/shop/purchase/{item_id} (purchase with coins), POST /api/shop/equip/{inventory_id} (equip item), POST /api/shop/unequip/{inventory_id} (unequip), POST /api/shop/use-shield (use streak shield), GET /api/shop/coin-history (transaction history). Admin endpoints: POST/PUT/DELETE /api/shop/admin/items, GET /api/shop/admin/stats. Frontend: ShopScreen.js with Shop/Inventory tabs, category filters, rarity colors, Featured Items section. EngagementStatus.jsx has coins-shop-link that navigates to /shop.
